principles: DeepSeek + pinned DSH remains the only agent kernel
No local model weights, training, GPU serving or second patient database
AI selects and interprets; code performs arithmetic and preserves inputs
An unavailable operation does not withhold other research or erase partial results
Uncertainty and missing evidence are represented, not fabricated

tasks.title: Longitudinal uploads and explicit field mappings
Task-specific data readiness without admission thresholds
Reuse source-anchored clinical extraction with assertion and medication state
Replay occurrence and availability clocks at the prediction origin
Resolve duplicates, correction chains and conflicting revisions
Immutable histories, predictions and incremental snapshot lineage
Reuse study grants, field grants and destination-specific cloud permission
Connect a real partner incremental feed
remaining: Requires the partner endpoint, incremental cursor semantics, credentials and authorized dataset. Existing FHIR/OMOP/ADaM intake and explicit priorHistoryId updates are implemented; no live partner connector is claimed.

tasks.title: Evidence-based candidate and API availability register
remaining: Candidate publications do not establish callable APIs or commercial/data-processing rights.

tasks.title: Versioned event-history and marginal endpoint prediction contract
remaining: v1 is marginal endpoint-by-horizon output. Joint event trajectories and multimodal model training are not implemented or represented as present.

tasks.title: Cloud batching, cancellation, replay, time/cost tracking and rollback
remaining: Only the generic cloud protocol is tested. Configure and probe an actual licensed provider. Cost is provider-reported; unknown charges cannot be bounded by a client-side estimate.

tasks.title: Import externally computed predictions
Re-predict from a new history or model while preserving prior versions
Per-row numerical meaning checks with partial retention
Keep literature scenarios and sensitivity analysis usable without a model
Separate synthetic engineering, clinical NLP and actual outcome evaluations
Freeze patient, calendar, site and trial-family splits
Same-subject persistence, trend and independent risk/trial baselines
Errors, calibration, distribution scoring, censoring and patient-cluster intervals
remaining: AUROC/AP use observed-at-horizon cases. IPCW uses marginal independent-censoring assumptions; conditional/competing-risk models and full trajectory-distribution scores require a separate model contract.

tasks.title: Keep predictive, parameter, model and Monte Carlo uncertainties distinct
remaining: Model and parameter uncertainty remain not estimated unless the external provider supplies the corresponding distribution. Patient bootstrap does not replace these.

tasks.title: Replay perturbations, freshness and local split shift diagnostics
Independent preserved-evidence RCT benchmark machinery
remaining: Requires rights-cleared independent trial predictions, preserved result sources and declared trial-family identities. No HealthFlux benchmark or clinical replication is claimed.

tasks.title: Dynamic endpoint forecasts at requested horizons
Paired model scenario contrasts with explicit causal limits
Translate saved common-subject forecasts to the existing design engine
Reuse prognostic adjustment and connect heldout correlations to PROCOVA design
remaining: Actual patient-level binary/survival adjustment uses the existing externally supplied, prespecified score-column workflow. This adapter does not relabel a forecast as an observed trial outcome or claim EMA qualification. Real clinical use needs independent validation and trial-specific pre-randomization inputs.

tasks.title: Predicted outcomes never become observed matching facts
Separate trial-effect models from patient trajectory predictions
remaining: No new treatment-effect model is trained or served locally. The module evaluates externally supplied trial-effect outputs; it does not infer causal identification from forecast differences.

tasks.title: Integrate history, import, versions and validation into the patient tab
Update all five DSH skills, existing tools and report number sources
T2D pilot across literature, longitudinal and imported-prediction paths
remaining: The executed pilot is authored synthetic data and a real DeepSeek API through pinned DSH. It is not real patient validation or a live dedicated world-model service.

tasks.title: Test arithmetic, permissions, provider failures, UI and real DeepSeek/DSH execution
remaining: Full hosted production deployment, real partner prediction service and prospective clinical validation are outside this isolated branch acceptance.
